project: Lead Intel Admin + shared Supabase (mobile consumes same DB)
notes: Middleware enforces only coarse URL prefixes; each Route Handler adds its own role checks.

users.role value 'viewer' (company 'App user' in team UX) is NOT the same as 'exhibitor_viewer' (read-only exhibitor web + mobile). Middleware allows only exhibitor_admin and exhibitor_viewer under /exhibitor and /app/exhibitor.
platform_admin is redirected away from organizer routes to /admin (middleware).

can: campaign and signal APIs as implemented (exhibitor_admin + platform_admin in app/api/campaigns and app/api/signals handlers)
support-style access patterns as coded per route
cannot: use organizer shell URLs (/app/organizer, /organizer) — redirected to /admin
use exhibitor-only URLs (/exhibitor/*) — redirected to role home (middleware)

can: view/manage data in organizer surfaces per RLS and route handlers
cannot: exhibitor URL prefixes without an exhibitor role (middleware)

can: full exhibitor web admin: leads CRUD (subject to RLS), import wizard, briefing approval, briefing knowledge
read/write lead_briefings per RLS and server routes
campaign and signal APIs (with platform_admin) as implemented
manage invites from exhibitor surfaces when handlers allow
read-focused exhibitor web routes allowed by middleware (with exhibitor_admin)
Supabase reads subject to RLS (e.g. leads, lead_briefings where policies permit)
bearer API read paths where handlers call canReadExhibitorLeadsInContext — mobile list may require eventId (see app/api/exhibitor/leads/list/route.ts)
cannot: campaign list/create APIs (403 — exhibitor_admin + platform_admin only)
signal list/create APIs (403 — exhibitor_admin + platform_admin only)
import wizard mutation routes (403 on guarded handlers)

viewer.description: Persisted users.role for company team 'App user'; used in team management and settings — not an exhibitor middleware role.
can: non-exhibitor app paths per product (e.g. /App shell at /app) where pages allow
operations explicitly coded for role === viewer

/admin: narrow exhibitor_admin exceptions: multi-event company license paths, Salesforce/Zapier admin integration paths
middleware_prefixes./campaigns: authenticated only at middleware — no exhibitor prefix check; API calls still 403 for non-admin roles

/admin/*.notes: See exceptions in lib/supabase/middleware.ts for exhibitor_admin on licensed routes

/api/exhibitor/*.notes: Per-handler: many writes are exhibitor_admin only; bearer mobile may need eventId for viewer role; platform_admin often not applicable

/api/campaigns.notes: Implemented in app/api/campaigns/route.ts — 403 for other roles including exhibitor_viewer and viewer

/api/invites/claim.notes: Public/authenticated claim flow — see handler for invite_codes + seat activation

leads.read: company_id and event scope per RLS + server helpers (assertEventIdAccessibleForUser when eventId supplied)
leads.write: exhibitor_admin (and platform flows); exhibitor_viewer blocked on mutation APIs

lead_briefings.read: company-scoped; RLS policies in migrations (exhibitor_admin sync + read paths); exhibitor lead detail RSC loads for scoped roles
lead_briefings.write: import approval sync + reconcilers; exhibitor admin operations per policies — not general viewer writes

campaigns.read_write_api: exhibitor_admin + platform_admin only in list/create handlers
campaigns.rls: company-scoped tenant rules apply for direct Supabase access

signals.read_write_api: exhibitor_admin + platform_admin in signals route handlers

licenses.read: organizer_admin within event scope, platform_admin globally — per surfaces
licenses.write: organizer/platform flows; entitlement math uses scope event|company and evaluateAppAccessGrant

event_users_and_invites.membership: Per-user per-event; exhibitor_company_id ties exhibitor staff to company
event_users_and_invites.permissions_json: Boolean flags admin and app (legacy array form normalized server-side). permissions.app participates in mobile seat licensing and canReadExhibitorLeadsInContext
event_users_and_invites.invite_codes: event_access_mode on row mirrors users.event_access_mode on redeem; permissions default {admin,app} booleans
event_users_and_invites.seat_enforcement: activateInvitedMembership* uses evaluateAppAccessGrant when permissions.app is true
